searchText: Ropsten seems to be doing well so far. I'm noticing some skipped slots as if there might be some offline validators. I can see grafitti from all 5 CL teams, so it doesn't appear to be implementation-specific. It's erigon, besu and a part of geth validators missing (they are missing because EL teams are not great at setting up infra in time :D) Previous epoch had ~70% of attesters agreeing to the target, so it seems like we'll finalize 🤞 If we finalize I can go back to bed 🛏️ 🌙 Finality! 🎉 Good night 😉 Credit due to Nethermind for breaking the trend 😄 TTD update notice for MSF6, new TTD is `50468767937878607003648` and aimed to hit tomorrow @ 2PM UTC. Configs can be found here: https://github.com/eth-clients/merge-testnets/tree/main/mainnet-shadow-fork-6 I'll be running a round of updates and using the latest version we recommend for Ropsten.
